lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Closed the review round 2 CRITICAL on src/tmux/dispatch.ts:462 (US-R1-001's content backstop, CAM-359): composerLineRetainsPayloadTail indexes the captured pane row by cursor_y, which is only valid for a VISIBLE-SCREEN capture (cursor_y counts rows from the top of the visible pane). But sendKeysVerified's backstop reused whatever capturePaneFn the caller injected for its own idle-gate/state-read purposes, and the sidecar's production notifyOrchestrator wiring (src/supervisor/host.ts) injects a FULL-SCROLLBACK reader (`capture-pane -p -S -`) for unrelated state reads elsewhere in the supervisor -- so on the sidecar's push path the backstop silently indexed an arbitrary scrollback history line instead of the true cursor row (reviewer's real-tmux probe on 3.6a confirmed the divergence: visible-screen line[23] vs -S - line[23] disagreed). Fix: decoupled the backstop onto a new `visibleCaptureFn` option on `sendKeysVerified` (src/tmux/dispatch.ts), always built fresh from `tmuxSpawnFn` via a dedicated `capture-pane -p -t <paneId>` call (no `-S -`) unless a test overrides it -- deliberately NOT derived from `capturePaneFn`, which now feeds ONLY the PRE-send idle-gate (`waitForIdlePane`; that check just scans the pane's last 5 lines and is insensitive to scrollback vs visible-screen framing, so no behavior change there). No new wiring needed at any call site (makeNotifyOrchestrator, the 4 thin-proxy commands): they all pick up the new default automatically since none of them previously threaded a `visibleCaptureFn`. Updated the fake-tmux-spawn test helpers in test/dispatch.test.ts (2 backstop tests switched from capturePaneFn to visibleCaptureFn + 1 new regression test proving a scrollback-shaped capturePaneFn no longer flips a genuinely-delivered verdict), test/supervisor/notify-orchestrator.test.ts, test/supervisor/host-notify-orch.test.ts, and test/single-pusher-guard.test.ts (each needed a new `capture-pane` branch in their fake spawnFn so the backstop's now-real capture-pane call isn't miscounted as a send-keys push, since their geometry fakes always read as ambiguous/matching and would otherwise always trigger the backstop). Real-tmux integration tests (test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts, test/integration/review-verdict-handback.test.ts) needed zero changes since neither ever injected an explicit capturePaneFn -- both already exercised a real visible-screen capture-pane call by default, both directions still green. Raised 5 file-size ceilings (host.ts, dispatch.ts, dispatch.test.ts, host-notify-orch.test.ts, notify-orchestrator.test.ts) to their new measured line counts with a dated _ref note. Full spine clean: typecheck 0 errors, bun test 5171 pass / 0 fail, bun run check:all all-green (embed-vendor n/a -- no vendor/templates touched, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps). No open threads for the next story.
